props.gloss_en: obvious: if the upper [outer] membrane is perforated and the lower [inner] is not, the lower protects
a lung that peeled [so that it looks] like a red date is kosher
the lower perforated and the upper not: [the upper] protects
the lower perforated and the upper not: [the upper] does not protect
Rav Yosef: a hissing lung -- if we know where it hisses we set a feather, saliva or straw on it; if it bubbles, tereifa
Rav Yosef: and if it does not [bubble], kosher
Rav Yosef: if we do not know where it hisses, we bring a basin of tepid water and set it inside
Rav Yosef: not in hot [water] -- for they contract
Rav Yosef: not in cold [water] -- for they harden
Rav Yosef: [if it does not bubble] the lower is perforated and the upper not, and the hissing is the air between [them]
mnemonic: dates, red, dried, scabs
Rava: a lung that reddened in part is kosher
Rava: [reddened] wholly -- tereifa
Ravina: why is 'in part' [kosher]? because it recovers
the baraita: and the other creeping and swarming creatures -- [only] once blood comes out of them
(entertained) we compare it [the reddened lung] to the eight sheratzim
the baraita [of the eight]: the blood collected, even though it did not come out
(inside the hypothesis) if so, even [reddened] in part [would be tereifa] too
Ravina: rather, there is no difference [between part and whole]
Rava: a lung that dried in part is tereifa
and how much? so that it crumbles under a fingernail
the baraita: which is 'dry'? one that, if perforated, does not give out a drop of blood
R' Yosei ben HaMeshullam: 'dry' -- so that it crumbles under a fingernail
the firstborn's ear, over which the wind holds sway, does not recover
but the lung, over which the air does not hold sway, recovers
Rava: a lung that stands in scabs, in black patches, in blotches of [various] appearance, is kosher
Rava (via Ameimar): one does not compare [by] cysts
Rava: two lobes adhering to one another have no inspection
we said this only out of their order
but in their order -- that is their growth
Rava: two cysts adjacent to one another have no inspection
Rava: one that looks like two -- we bring a thorn and pierce it
if they pour into one another, it is one and kosher
and if not, they are two and tereifa
Rava: the lung has five lobes -- its face toward the man, three on the right and two on the left
Rava: [a lobe] missing ... or switched -- tereifa
Rava: or [a lobe] extra -- tereifa
Mareimar declared the extra-lobed [lung] kosher
Rav Acha [to the owner]: go back and bring it in before him
Mareimar: go tell the one sitting at the door: the halakha is not as Rava in [the case of] an extra lobe
and this applies where it stands in the row of the lobes
but in between -- tereifa
Rav Huna Mar bar Avya: all field animals have this, and the butchers call it 'the little rose-eye'
and this applies on the inside
but on its back, even [as small] as a myrtle leaf -- tereifa
Rafram: a lung that resembles a wood-chip is tereifa
some say: [the likeness is] in appearance
and some say: in feel
some say: that it is swollen
and some say: that it is light
and some say: that it is smooth, having no division of lobes
Rava: like kohl -- kosher
Rava: like ink -- tereifa
R' Chanina: black is red, except that it was stricken
green -- kosher, from R' Natan
red -- kosher, from R' Natan
R' Natan (overseas): I saw he was red; I told her: my daughter, wait for him until his blood is absorbed in him. She waited, circumcised him, and he lived
R' Natan (Cappadocia): I saw he was green; I looked and there was no blood of the covenant in him; I told her: wait until his blood falls into him. She waited, circumcised him, and he lived
Rav Kahana: like liver -- kosher
Rav Kahana: like flesh -- tereifa
Rav Kahana: and your mnemonic -- 'flesh torn in the field' (Ex 22:30)
Rav Sama son of Rava: a lung that resembles dodder, or saffron, or the colour of egg [yolk] is tereifa
then what is the kosher green like? like leeks
Ravina: a sealed [area] in the lung -- we bring a knife and tear it
if there is pus in it, it is surely due to the pus, and kosher
and if not, we set a feather or saliva on it; if it bubbles, kosher
and if not, tereifa
Rav Yosef: a membrane that grew due to a wound in the lung is not a membrane
R' Yochanan (via Ulla): a lung that poured out like a jug is kosher
evidently he holds: a lack on the inside is not called a lack
the mishna (cited): a lung that was perforated or that was lacking [is tereifa]
'lacking' [in the mishna] means [lacking] on the outside
R' Abba: is it not rather [lacking] on the inside?
R' Abba: if you say on the outside -- that is [the same as] 'perforated'
R' Abba: and learn from it: a lack on the inside IS called a lack
R' Shimon (cited): [the perforated lung is tereifa only] when it is perforated to the bronchi
this applies [only] to a perforation that has no lack
but a perforation that has a lack -- even R' Shimon concedes [it is tereifa]
Rava: provided the bronchi remain
Rav Ashi: we bring a glazed vessel and pour it into it
Rav Ashi: if there are white streaks in it -- tereifa
Rav Ashi: and if not -- kosher
Rav Nachman: a lung that wasted away with its membrane intact is kosher
the baraita: a lung that wasted away with its membrane intact, even [the space] holding a revi'it -- kosher
the baraita: its shalpuchit [sac] removed -- kosher
its liver became wormy -- there was such a case: the people of Asia went up about it to Yavne three festivals, and at the third festival they permitted it to them

Rava: a lung that reddened in part is kosher
Rava: [reddened] wholly -- tereifa
Ravina: why is 'in part' [kosher]? because it recovers

nodes.label_he: ושאר שקצים ורמשים -- עד שיצא מהם דם
nodes.label_en: the baraita: and the other creeping and swarming creatures -- [only] once blood comes out of them

nodes.label_he: וכי תימא: לשמונה שרצים מדמינן לה
nodes.label_en: (entertained) we compare it [the reddened lung] to the eight sheratzim

nodes.label_he: דתניא: נצרר הדם, אף על פי שלא יצא
nodes.label_en: the baraita [of the eight]: the blood collected, even though it did not come out
(inside the hypothesis) if so, even [reddened] in part [would be tereifa] too
Ravina: rather, there is no difference [between part and whole]
Rava: a lung that dried in part is tereifa
and how much? so that it crumbles under a fingernail

nodes.label_he: איזו היא יבשה -- שאם תינקב ואינה מוציאה טיפת דם
nodes.label_en: the baraita: which is 'dry'? one that, if perforated, does not give out a drop of blood

nodes.label_he: רבי יוסי בן המשולם אומר: יבשה כדי שתהא נפרכת בציפורן
nodes.label_en: R' Yosei ben HaMeshullam: 'dry' -- so that it crumbles under a fingernail

nodes.label_he: גבי אוזן בכור דקא שליט ביה זיקא -- לא הדרא בריא
nodes.label_en: the firstborn's ear, over which the wind holds sway, does not recover

nodes.label_he: אבל ריאה דלא קא שליט בה אוירא -- הדרא בריא
nodes.label_en: but the lung, over which the air does not hold sway, recovers

nodes.label_he: האי ריאה דקיימא גילדי גילדי, אוכמי אוכמי, חזוותא חזוותא -- כשרה
nodes.label_en: Rava: a lung that stands in scabs, in black patches, in blotches of [various] appearance, is kosher
Rava (via Ameimar): one does not compare [by] cysts

nodes.label_he: הני תרתי אוני דסריכן להדדי -- לית להו בדיקה
nodes.label_en: Rava: two lobes adhering to one another have no inspection
we said this only out of their order
but in their order -- that is their growth

nodes.label_he: הני תרתי בועי דסמיכן להדדי -- לית להו בדיקותא
nodes.label_en: Rava: two cysts adjacent to one another have no inspection

nodes.label_he: חדא ומתחזיא כתרתי -- מייתינן סילוא ובזעינן לה
nodes.label_en: Rava: one that looks like two -- we bring a thorn and pierce it

nodes.label_he: אי שפכן להדדי -- חדא היא וכשרה
nodes.label_en: if they pour into one another, it is one and kosher
and if not, they are two and tereifa

nodes.label_he: חמש אוני אית לה לריאה, אפה כלפי גברא -- תלתא מימינא ותרתי משמאלא
nodes.label_en: Rava: the lung has five lobes -- its face toward the man, three on the right and two on the left
Rava: [a lobe] missing ... or switched -- tereifa
Rava: or [a lobe] extra -- tereifa
Mareimar declared the extra-lobed [lung] kosher
Rav Acha [to the owner]: go back and bring it in before him

nodes.label_he: זיל אימא ליה למאן דיתיב אבבא: לית הלכתא כוותיה דרבא ביתרת
nodes.label_en: Mareimar: go tell the one sitting at the door: the halakha is not as Rava in [the case of] an extra…
and this applies where it stands in the row of the lobes
but in between -- tereifa

nodes.label_he: כל הני חיוי ברייתא הכי אית להו, וקרו לה טבחי עינוניתא דוורדא
nodes.label_en: Rav Huna Mar bar Avya: all field animals have this, and the butchers call it 'the little rose-eye'
and this applies on the inside

nodes.label_he: אבל אגבה, אפילו כטרפא דאסא -- טרפה
nodes.label_en: but on its back, even [as small] as a myrtle leaf -- tereifa
Rafram: a lung that resembles a wood-chip is tereifa
some say: [the likeness is] in appearance
and some say: in feel
some say: that it is swollen
and some say: that it is light

nodes.label_he: ואיכא דאמרי דשיעא, דלית לה חיתוכא דאוני
nodes.label_en: and some say: that it is smooth, having no division of lobes
Rava: like kohl -- kosher
Rava: like ink -- tereifa
R' Chanina: black is red, except that it was stricken
green -- kosher, from R' Natan
red -- kosher, from R' Natan

nodes.label_he: ראיתיו שהיה אדום, אמרתי לה: בתי, המתיני לו עד שיבלע בו דמו. המתינה לו ומלה אותו וחיה
nodes.label_en: R' Natan (overseas): I saw he was red; I told her: my daughter, wait for him until his blood is abs…

nodes.label_he: ראיתיו שהיה ירוק, הצצתי בו ולא היה בו דם ברית, אמרתי לה: בתי, המתיני לו עד שיפול בו דמו. המתינה לו ומלה אותו וחיה
nodes.label_en: R' Natan (Cappadocia): I saw he was green; I looked and there was no blood of the covenant in him;…
Rav Kahana: like liver -- kosher
Rav Kahana: like flesh -- tereifa
Rav Kahana: and your mnemonic -- 'flesh torn in the field' (Ex 22:30)

nodes.label_he: האי ריאה דדמיא ככשותא, וכמוריקא, וכגון ביעתא -- טרפה
nodes.label_en: Rav Sama son of Rava: a lung that resembles dodder, or saffron, or the colour of egg [yolk] is tere…

nodes.label_he: אלא ירוקה דכשרה היכי דמיא? ככרתי
nodes.label_en: then what is the kosher green like? like leeks

nodes.label_he: אטום בריאה -- מייתינן סכינא וקרעינן לה
nodes.label_en: Ravina: a sealed [area] in the lung -- we bring a knife and tear it

nodes.label_he: אי אית בה מוגלא -- ודאי מחמת מוגלא הוא, וכשרה
nodes.label_en: if there is pus in it, it is surely due to the pus, and kosher

nodes.label_he: ואי לא -- מותבינן עלה גדפא או רוקא, אי מבצבצא -- כשרה
nodes.label_en: and if not, we set a feather or saliva on it; if it bubbles, kosher

nodes.label_he: קרום שעלה מחמת מכה בריאה -- אינו קרום
nodes.label_en: Rav Yosef: a membrane that grew due to a wound in the lung is not a membrane
R' Yochanan (via Ulla): a lung that poured out like a jug is kosher

nodes.label_he: אלמא קסבר: חסרון מבפנים לא שמיה חסרון
nodes.label_en: evidently he holds: a lack on the inside is not called a lack
the mishna (cited): a lung that was perforated or that was lacking [is tereifa]
'lacking' [in the mishna] means [lacking] on the outside
R' Abba: is it not rather [lacking] on the inside?
R' Abba: if you say on the outside -- that is [the same as] 'perforated'

nodes.label_he: ושמע מינה: חסרון מבפנים שמיה חסרון
nodes.label_en: R' Abba: and learn from it: a lack on the inside IS called a lack

nodes.label_he: רבי שמעון, דאמר: עד שתנקב לבית הסמפונות
nodes.label_en: R' Shimon (cited): [the perforated lung is tereifa only] when it is perforated to the bronchi

nodes.label_he: הני מילי נקב דלית ביה חסרון
nodes.label_en: this applies [only] to a perforation that has no lack

nodes.label_he: אבל נקב דאית ביה חסרון -- אפילו רבי שמעון מודה
nodes.label_en: but a perforation that has a lack -- even R' Shimon concedes [it is tereifa]

nodes.label_he: אי אית בה שורייקי חיורי -- טרפה
